headline: Tres audiencias sobre depósitos de seguridad entre inquilinos y dueños de propiedades en disputa.
summary: La Junta de Revisión de Vivienda va a celebrar audiencias sobre tres casos de depósitos de seguridad entre inquilinos y dueños de propiedades. Las propiedades implicadas son 106 Birch Court, 73 Buell Street Apt. 1, y 54B Intervale Avenue.
items: Caso de Depósito de Seguridad: Kyla Rathbone (inquilina) contra Ertan Barucic (dueño), Respecto a: 106 Birch Court
Caso de Depósito de Seguridad: Jonah Cather-Walter y Jonas Tenzer (inquilinos) contra Gardner Properties LLC c/o Neil Gardner (dueño), Respecto a: 73 Buell Street Apt. 1
Caso de Depósito de Seguridad: Lana Peters (inquilina) contra MR Dupont Real Estate, LLC c/o Daniel Hogan (dueño), Respecto a: 54B Intervale Avenue
review: summary: The Spanish adds a board name, "La Junta de Revisión de Vivienda" (Housing Review Board). The English only says "The board" and gives no name, so the translation invents a specific body. It should say "La junta".; headline: "over disputed properties" is rendered as "propiedades en disputa", which attaches the dispute to the properties and drops the idea that the hearings are about disputes over the deposits. The English also says hearings "over disputed properties", but the Spanish wording could be read as the landlords being owners of properties in dispute. This changes the meaning slightly.
